ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/java var limit = payload.limit as Number default 200 var offset = payload.offset as Number default 0 var sfId = payload.sfId default null --- { query: "SELECT Id, FirstName, LastName, PersonEmail, Phone, AccountNumber, TaxId__c, Status__c FROM Contact " ++ (if (sfId != null) "WHERE Id = '" ++ sfId ++ "' " else "") ++ "LIMIT " ++ limit as String ++ " OFFSET " ++ offset as String }

%dw 2.0 output application/java var queryParams = payload var sfId = queryParams.sfId default null --- // Mock Salesforce query response { records: if (sfId != null and sfId != "") [{ Id: sfId, FirstName: "John", LastName: "Doe", PersonEmail: "john.doe@example.com", Phone: "+1234567890", AccountNumber: "CUST-000001", TaxId__c: "TAX-123456", Status__c: "Active" }] else [ { Id: "SF-001", FirstName: "John", LastName: "Doe", PersonEmail: "john.doe@example.com", Phone: "+1234567890", AccountNumber: "CUST-000001", TaxId__c: "TAX-123456", Status__c: "Active" }, { Id: "SF-002", FirstName: "Jane", LastName: "Smith", PersonEmail: "jane.smith@example.com", Phone: "+1234567891", AccountNumber: "CUST-000002", TaxId__c: "TAX-789012", Status__c: "Active" } ], totalSize: 2, done: true }

%dw 2.0 output application/json var result = payload[0] var originalPayload = vars.payload --- { id: null, globalId: null, externalIds: [{ system: "Salesforce", value: result.id }], customerNumber: originalPayload.contact.AccountNumber, party: originalPayload.contact, status: originalPayload.contact.Status__c default "Active" }
